sense: a post or prop for plants

terms.gloss: a stake, a post, a prop
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 4.4.4: ut fīgam pālum in parietem (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: a prop, a support for a vine
evidence: Cic. ND 2.120: vītēs clāviculīs adminicula, tamquam manibus apprehendunt (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: At first the vine-dresser’s word for the pole a vine climbs; then any support (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: hic docuit teneram pālīs adjungere vītem
phrases.english: he taught men to tie the tender vine to stakes

phrases.latin: vītēs clāviculīs adminicula, tamquam manibus apprehendunt
phrases.english: vines take hold of their props with their tendrils as if with hands

sources: Lewis & Short: palus · Lewis & Short: ridica · Lewis & Short: adminiculum
